_readme: Drop licensed pixel-art vista scenes (PNG, ~360x140 logical px, 16/32px tiles) into
this directory and list them under 'stages' keyed by VistaStage name. Stages without
an entry use the built-in placeholder silhouettes. Integer scaling + FilterQuality.None
are applied automatically — author at exact pixel sizes, never pre-scale.
Record every pack in ATTRIBUTION.md. CC0 preferred; never NC/ND licenses.
